headline: Iran vows 'long and painful strikes' on US positions across the Gulf if Washington renews attacks
dek: IRGC senior official: any new US attack on Iran, 'even if limited', brings 'long and painful strikes' on US regional positions. Aerospace commander Majid Mousavi: 'We've seen what happened to your regional bases, we will see the same thing happen to your warships.' Khamenei (written message):…
sources: Al Jazeera ('Iran vows long, painful response if US renews attacks'); on-record quotes: IRGC aerospace force commander Majid Mousavi (via Iranian media), Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei (written message), US Sen. Richard
fault_line: Deterrence or bluff: does Iran's 'long and painful' threat keep Washington from striking, or is the weekend-strike talk already past the point of threats?

sections.what_happened: IRGC senior official: any new US attack on Iran, 'even if limited', brings 'long and painful strikes' on US regional positions. Aerospace commander Majid Mousavi: 'We've seen what happened to your regional bases, we will see the same thing happen to your warships.' Khamenei (written message): 'enemies' abuses of the waterway' will be eliminated under new management of the strait; 'Foreigners who come from thousands of kilometres away... have no place there except at the bottom of its waters.' UAE banned citizens' travel to Iran/Lebanon/Iraq (Thursday); Gargash: 'No unilateral Iranian arrangements can be trusted.' Bahrain's king condemned Iranian 'aggression'. Blumenthal (CNN): 'imminent military strike very much on the table' — 'deeply disturbing'. Axios: Trump briefed Thursday on further military strike plans to pressure Iran.
sections.what_verified: Single declared-tier family (Al Jazeera T2 STATE(QA)) for the roundup; the embedded quotes are named on-record primary statements reported with attribution.
sections.what_disputed: US envoy/Trump line (covered 0100-02): Trump 'I don't know anything' about a weekend strike, hours after envoy Tom Barrack floated a possible weekend strike — Washington's public posture is deliberately ambiguous. Senior US official (Axios): for the War Powers clock, hostilities ceased with the April ceasefire (clock reset).
sections.why_matters: The threats are now reciprocal and on the record: Tehran promises 'long and painful' strikes on US bases and warships; a US senator says a strike is 'very much on the table.' Nobody is de-escalating in words.
sections.context: Background: UPDATE (big-missed; published 04:36 today) -- Al Jazeera roundup: Iran vows 'long and painful strikes' on US positions across the Gulf if Washington renews attacks; IRGC aerospace commander Mousavi: 'we will see the same thing happen to your warships'; Khamenei written message; Blumenthal (CNN): 'imminent military strike very much on the table'; Axios: Trump briefed Thursday on further strike plans.

totw_analysis: Our read: The threats are now reciprocal and on the record: Tehran promises 'long and painful' strikes on US bases and warships; a US senator says a strike is 'very much on the table.' Nobody is de-escalating in words. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Deterrence or bluff: does Iran's 'long and painful' threat keep Washington from striking, or is the weekend-strike talk already past the point of threats?
